image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of the head and upper neck of a Nile crocodile resting on sandy ground. The image focuses on the textured skin, the eye with a vertical pupil, and the interlocking teeth of the closed jaw.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers to a distinct point (V-shape), distinguishing it from the U-shape of an alligator. The head structure is broad and consistent with Crocodylus niloticus.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is closed, yet multiple large, conical teeth from the lower jaw protrude through notches in the upper jaw, demonstrating the characteristic interlocking mechanism.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is clearly visible on the top of the skull. It features a sharp vertical slit pupil. A translucent film (nictitating membrane) appears to be partially covering or protecting the eye, which is biologically accurate.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The extreme tip of the snout where the nostrils are located is cut off by the right edge of the image frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the neck and shoulder shows thick, rugged skin indicative of heavy armor.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal surface behind the head displays raised, bony ridges and scales consistent with osteoderms.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is a mix of muddy greens, browns, and greys. The texture is highly detailed, showing cracks and roughness typical of reptile skin.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image angle is from above/side; the belly (ventral surface) is completely occluded by the body and the ground.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No limbs or feet are visible in this tight headshot crop.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is outside the frame.

alignment_reasoning: All testable checkpoints for the head and visible body parts are perfectly met. The V-shaped snout, interlocking teeth, dorsal eye position with vertical pupil, and rough scute texture are biologically accurate and visually distinct. Non-testable checkpoints are due to framing, not generation errors.
